contests.title: Sergeant Bluff-Luton Community School District — Measure WD: Primary school bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Woodbury County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
Sergeant Bluff-Luton Community School
District in the County of Woodbury, State
of Iowa, be authorized to contract
indebtedness and issue General
Obligation Bonds in an amount not to
exceed $38,000,000 to provide funds to
build, furnish, and equip a new Primary
School building as an addition to the
Elementary building (including demolition
of the existing Primary building) and
improve the site?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $38 million in general-obligation bonds for a new primary school building added to the elementary building, demolition of the existing primary building, furniture and equipment, and site improvements.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the primary school construction bonds.
